kp2:1.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from killing living creatures,
kp2:2.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from taking what has not been given,
kp2:3.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from unchastity,
kp2:4.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from false speech,
kp2:5.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from liquor, wines, or intoxicants which cause heedlessness,
kp2:6.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from eating at the wrong time,
kp2:7.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from dances, songs, music, and watching shows,
kp2:8.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from adorning or ornamenting (myself) by wearing garlands, scents, or ointments,
kp2:9.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from lofty or grand beds,
kp2:10.1: I undertake the training rule of refraining from accepting gold or money.
